entities.name: Acid substrate
observations: SELFIES decodes to O=C(O)CNC(=O)c1cc(-c2ccc(F)cc2)[nH]n1; ORD match supports use as acyl partner.

entities.name: Piperidine nucleophile
observations: Secondary piperidine bearing a chloropyridyl ether; its N–H forms the amide in the matched coupling, retaining aryl chloride.

entities.name: EDCI HOBt coupling
observations: ORD match indicates EDCI/HOBt activation, DIPEA base, and DMF solvent for amide formation; additional diaryl ketone, water, and chloride inputs may be spectators or record artifacts.
